description:
"Sinful Spoils"―Cursed treasures that grant immense power at the cost of bringing disaster and ruin.
Following a peculiar rumor, "Diabellstar", known as the "Seeker of the Sinful Spoils", arrives at an ancient temple.
After defeating the "Snake-Eye" and other monsters to reach the temple`s depths, Diabellstar is confronted by the Sinful Spoil incarnate, the "Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon".
Calling upon the power of her own Sinful Spoil, Diabellstar succeeds in bringing down the colossal dragon.
But just as she reaches for her prize, the "Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye", something completely unexpected bursts forth from within...
Source: Official English Website

titles.title: Seeker of the Sinful Spoils I: "Diabellstar the Black Witch"
